summary: OpticalTel and Fibernow are one continuing platform rather than duplicate companies. DigitalBridge Partners III invested through DBP III Snowbird BidCo on February 29, 2024, the public Fibernow rebrand followed in October, InfraBridge is not a direct owner, Wavetechs is an integrated add-on, and no later company-level exit or pending Fibernow transfer was found.
